title: SERVICE_REQUEST ssh-connection before authentication ends the connection without DISCONNECT
quote: If the server rejects the service request, it SHOULD send an appropriate SSH_MSG_DISCONNECT message and MUST disconnect.
rationale: Before authentication, SR_CONN ends the connection with no DISCONNECT in that step (v1 D6: Dropbear, Go; OpenSSH sends DISCONNECT). Written by proto-sm stream A (v2) from v1 class D6 (report.md); vocabulary: teammate mapper (UNIMPLEMENTED, SERVICE_ACCEPT, CLOSED/NO_CONN, UA_PW_OK). An accepting word is a behaviour witness, not necessarily a bug.
